summary: Iteration 19 (Phase 22) — auto-crown + consolation-prize + rewards. Backend 10/10 pytest passed (put-requires-auth, put-rejects-non-commissioner, put-commissioner-ok, get-reflects-put, compensation_pick type, custom type, unauth-GET-ok, team-rewards shape, no-ObjectId leak, health). End-to-end `python /app/backend/test_crown_flow.py` passed — champion + consolation crowned, lottery boost applied (2027 R1 #3, boost=3), team_reward recorded with team_name.
